questions.question: Between Stellantis and ASML, which company was more profitable in 2025?
questions.gold_facts: ASML was clearly more profitable: net income of about EUR 9.6 billion (net margin ~29%). Stellantis reported a net LOSS of about EUR 22.3 billion in 2025.

questions.question: How did TotalEnergies' hydrocarbon production evolve between 2024 and 2025?
questions.gold_facts: Combined production increased from 2,434 kboe/d in 2024 to 2,529 kboe/d in 2025, an increase of roughly 4%.

questions.question: What drove Stellantis' operating loss in 2025?
questions.gold_facts: Operating loss of about EUR 26.3 billion, driven by large one-off charges. Most notable: platform impairments of EUR 6,583 million (largest component in North America) following reduced volume and profitability expectations. Other charges named in the report include the Takata airbags recall campaign (EUR 622 million), restructuring costs (~EUR 913 million), and further unusual items detailed in the notes (product plan realignments / program cancellations, warranty provision changes, battery capacity rationalization). An answer is correct if it attributes the loss to these one-off charges, with the platform impairments figure right.
